review_scope_statement: Documentary only. The technical findings of post-execution review revision 2 were not re-adjudicated and are carried forward as PASS on their own terms. One direct contradiction was found and is reported; it is documentary, not technical.

verbatim_authorization_text_hash_check.probative_value: NONE_FOR_PROVENANCE — the digest is computed over text stored in the same file that asserts the digest. It demonstrates internal self-consistency only and corroborates neither the existence nor the timing of the asserted authorization event.

integrity_gate.note: Integrity of the supplied bundle is complete and recomputed from bytes at every level. Integrity is not authorization.

independence_satisfied.basis: Fresh context. This reviewer authored none of the runner, the execution, the evidence package, the authorization record, the reconciliation note, the scope file, the prior reviews or the review request. Every hash, byte count and parse was recomputed locally from the supplied bytes. Declared hashes, declared dispositions and narrative assertions were treated as untrusted claims requiring verification. No network access, no GitHub access and no execution of any kind was performed.

documentary_disposition_reason: Two of the three items B-01 required were genuinely supplied and verify: HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE.json in full at the exact 1254 bytes and hash previously described but absent, and a reconciliation note whose temporal argument is internally sound. The third and decisive item was not supplied. B-01 required the Human Gate D authorization artifact that authorized attempt 2, hash- and byte-identified and dated between the runner-candidate review and execution start. What arrived instead is a record created at 2026-08-20T19:55:47Z, after execution and after revision 2 raised the finding, which by its own status field is a retrospective narration of an asserted event, whose only integrity anchor is a digest of its own text. Separately and independently, the scope binding fails: the verbatim human sentence does not state the mutation scope but delegates it to 'EL GATE ANTERIOR', a referent identified by no hash and no byte count, and the only prior gate supplied lists as NOT AUTHORIZED precisely the mutations that were performed. The gap is unchanged in kind from B-01 and remains closable without re-execution.

required_items_assessment.assessment: NOT_SATISFIED. The file supplied is dated 2026-08-20T19:55:47Z, outside the required window, and self-declares as RETROSPECTIVE_DOCUMENTARY_RECORD. It is a later assertion about an artifact, not the artifact.

required_items_assessment.assessment: NOT_SATISFIED_AS_AUTHORIZATION. Those exact objects are named, and they match observed reality without divergence, but they are named only inside the post-execution record's authorized_scope block, not inside any human-authored text and not inside the gate the human sentence actually incorporates.
SATISFIED. Present, 1254 bytes, sha256 619b3a77..., matching the byte count revision 2 attributed to it while recording it as absent.

required_items_assessment.item: Reconciliation note explaining the relationship between the gate and the read-only 'Authorized next step' line at production main 5a5b4b1b
required_items_assessment.assessment: SATISFIED_IN_FORM. The note is present and its temporal argument is coherent. Its soundness as reconciliation depends on the asserted authorization event, which is not independently evidenced.

B_01_disposition.what_would_close_it: Contemporaneous provenance for the 2026-08-19T19:45:10Z decision that does not originate from the asserting party after the fact, plus exact identification of the incorporated scope. Any one of the first group, combined with the second, would convert this to PASS on documentary review alone and without re-execution.

authorization_event_assessment.confirmation_basis: The value 2026-08-19T19:45:10Z appears in the authorization record and is consistent everywhere it recurs across the bundle. No artifact independent of the asserting party corroborates it.
authorization_event_assessment.provenance_gap_note: Revision 2 named exactly these as missing: no invocation record, no environment attestation, no signed or hashed authorization artifact, no dated decision naming attempt 2. Every one of them is still missing. The bundle adds narration where attestation was required.

temporal_ordering.precision_caveat: The review completion bound is 2026-08-19T00:00:00Z, exact midnight, which is date granularity rather than an observed instant. Adopted here without objection only because B-01 itself adopted the same bound.

record_creation_vs_execution.note: The authorization record, the reconciliation note and the review request all carry the identical creation instant 2026-08-20T19:55:47Z, three minutes and forty-seven seconds after revision 2 recorded B-01. This is not itself misconduct and is consistent with an honest attempt to document an omitted decision, but it means the entire closure package was composed in response to the finding rather than retrieved from a record predating it.

scope_binding_assessment.verbatim_scope_clause_effect: The authorizing sentence states the scope, STOP and prohibitions are those defined in 'EL GATE ANTERIOR'. It enumerates no repository, no branch, no SHA, no pull request number, no token mint, no check-run surface and no evidence directory.

post_hoc_composition_evidence.finding: The authorized_scope block embeds observed_check_run_id 96206259472 and 96206266309.
post_hoc_composition_evidence.significance: Check-run identifiers are assigned by GitHub at creation time during execution. A scope composed at or before authorization could not contain them. Their presence inside a block labelled authorized_scope demonstrates that this block is a post-execution reconstruction rather than a transcription of a pre-existing scope.
post_hoc_composition_evidence.severity: STRUCTURAL — it does not prove the authorization was absent, but it removes the block's capacity to serve as evidence that a scope existed beforehand.

Perfect agreement is what both an accurate contemporaneous scope and a post-hoc transcription would produce, so it does not discriminate between them.

sub_assessments.detail: The line states that any later execution or D mutation requires a new Human Gate D. This is a condition, not a prohibition, so a later gate is the contemplated path and not a violation. This element of the reconciliation is correct.

sub_assessments.claim: The 19 August gate is that later gate
sub_assessments.detail: Depends entirely on the asserted authorization event, for which no independent provenance is supplied. The condition R2_STATE.md set is satisfiable, and may in fact have been satisfied, but the bundle does not demonstrate it.

sub_assessments.detail: The intent is explicit and repeated, the authority_boundary statements are correctly restrictive, and no artifact purports to grant execution now. But because the authorizing scope exists only in a document composed after execution, the distinction between recording a prior authorization and constructing one after the fact is asserted rather than demonstrated. That distinction is precisely what B-01 exists to test.

sub_assessments.detail: R2-4 exit NOT_EXECUTED, next phase NO, R2-5 NOT_AUTHORIZED, L2 not authorized and not started, D1/D2/D3 not authorized, cleanup not authorized, canonicalization not yet authorized, ENFORCED false, FALSE_GREENS 8. Nothing in this bundle alters any of these, and no artifact attempts to.

R2_STATE_reconciliation_assessment.note: Applying temporal ordering does dissolve the apparent conflict with R2_STATE.md as a matter of logic. What it cannot do is supply the missing proof that the event it relies on occurred.

HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE_reconciliation_assessme.basis: artifact_type is r2-4-stage-b-v14-v2-runner-candidate-human-gate-scope. Its authorized list covers only constructing one local runner candidate, static and simulated validation, and preparing one independent-review request.
HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE_reconciliation_assessme.withholding_basis: candidate_execution_authority is NONE, and not_authorized includes execute candidate main, network or GitHub mutation, open PR #2, branch/check/status/ruleset/protection mutation, installation token or PEM use, production or PR #6 mutation, reopen PR #1, and L2/canonicalization/cleanup/D1/D2/D3/phase change/R2-5.
HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE_reconciliation_assessme.anticipation_basis: Its bindings state that candidate execution additionally requires exact independent runner PASS and a later Human Gate D. The withholding is therefore conditional and forward-looking, not absolute.

supersession_of_execution_prohibition.detail: Because HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE.json itself names the later Human Gate D as the unlocking condition, a genuine later gate would supersede its execution prohibition without contradiction. Mandatory check 6 is satisfied.
supersession_of_execution_prohibition.limitation: Supersession removes a prohibition. It does not supply an affirmative mutation scope. The repository, SHAs, PR number, token mints, check-run surfaces and evidence root had to come from somewhere, and this file is not that source.
supersession_of_execution_prohibition.circularity_note: The verbatim gate takes its scope from 'el gate anterior'; the reconciliation says the later gate superseded the earlier scope; the only statement of the superseding scope is the retrospective record itself. The chain closes on the asserting party with no external anchor.

blocking_findings.title: The supplied authorization artifact is a post-dated self-attestation, not the artifact B-01 required
evidence: record_created_at_utc is 2026-08-20T19:55:47Z, which is after execution start 2026-08-19T19:54:25Z and after revision 2 completed at 2026-08-20T19:52:00Z. B-01 required an artifact dated between 2026-08-19T00:00:00Z and 2026-08-19T19:54:25Z.
The file's own status field reads RETROSPECTIVE_DOCUMENTARY_RECORD_OF_PREEXISTING_AUTHORIZATION_NOT_NEW_AUTHORITY.
verbatim_text_sha256 recomputes correctly under UTF-8/NFC, but hashes text held in the same file, so it evidences no provenance.

The four provenance classes revision 2 named as missing remain missing: invocation record, environment attestation of R2_V14_V2_ATTEMPT2_HUMAN_GATE_D, signed or externally timestamped artifact, and a dated decision document naming attempt 2.
The authorization record, reconciliation note and review request share the identical creation instant, 227 seconds after the finding was raised.
blocking_findings.why_this_blocks: Canonicalization writes into the canonical governance record. Admitting an authorization on the strength of the asserting party's later account of it is the precise failure mode this gate exists to prevent, and matches the FALSE_GREEN_7 class already recorded eight times in this project's history.
blocking_findings.why_this_is_not_BLOCKED_AUTHORIZATION_NO: Nothing here refutes the authorization or shows the mutation exceeded any boundary. Revision 2 verified the technical surface as exact with no excursion, no false green, no merge, no production or PR #6 drift and a safe CLOSED_UNMERGED terminal state. The deficiency is evidentiary and remediable, so the proportionate disposition is CHANGES_REQUIRED rather than BLOCKED.
blocking_findings.required_change: Supply provenance for the 2026-08-19T19:45:10Z decision that does not originate from the asserting party after the fact. Any one suffices: a conversation export or transcript containing the message with its surrounding context and an identifier; a transcript or artifact hash that was pinned at or before execution; a runner invocation record or environment attestation captured during the execution window showing the R2_V14_V2_ATTEMPT2_HUMAN_GATE_D value actually presented; or an external signature or timestamp over the decision.

blocking_findings.title: The verbatim authorization incorporates its scope from an unidentified prior gate, and the only supplied candidate forbids the mutations that were performed
evidence: The verbatim sentence delegates scope with 'CON EL ALCANCE, STOP Y PROHIBICIONES DEFINIDOS EN EL GATE ANTERIOR' and enumerates no repository, branch, SHA, PR number, token mint, check-run surface or evidence directory.
'EL GATE ANTERIOR' is identified by no filename, no sha256 and no byte count anywhere in the bundle.

The only prior gate supplied, HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE.json, lists under not_authorized: 'open PR #2', 'installation token or PEM use', 'network or GitHub mutation' and 'branch/check/status/ruleset/protection mutation', and sets candidate_execution_authority to NONE.
Executed under this authorization: PR #2 opened and closed, two installation tokens minted, two App check-runs created. Those are the acts the incorporated scope prohibits.
Keyword scan of HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE.json finds the lab repository name, both target and source SHAs, both app IDs, both installation IDs, the evidence root and the term check-run all absent.

All nine scope limits required by mandatory check 4 appear together only in the authorized_scope block of the post-execution record, which itself embeds post-execution check-run IDs 96206259472 and 96206266309 and therefore cannot predate execution.
blocking_findings.why_this_blocks: This is the direct contradiction the review instruction reserved as grounds for looking past the documentary layer. Read literally, the authorizing sentence adopts a scope that forbids the acts it is said to authorize. Either the referent is HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE.json, in which case the authorization contradicts itself on the mutation surface, or it is a different document, in which case that document is absent and its content unverifiable. Neither reading permits confirming mandatory check 4.
blocking_findings.required_change: Identify 'EL GATE ANTERIOR' by exact sha256 and byte count. If it is not HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE.json, supply it in full and demonstrate that its scope covers the lab repository, PR #2, both target and source SHAs, both installation-token mints, both App check-run surfaces, close-without-merge and the evidence root. If it is HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE.json, the contradiction must be addressed directly rather than by supersession, since supersession lifts a prohibition but supplies no affirmative scope.

nonblocking_findings.detail: 2026-08-19T00:00:00Z is exact midnight, a normalized date rather than an observed instant, so 'review precedes authorization' holds with a nominal rather than measured margin. Not pressed, because B-01 adopted the same bound when specifying the required window.

Credited as favorable. Non-probative of prior authorization, since a post-hoc scope reproduces execution by construction.

false_green_increment.basis: This review performed no execution, no mutation and no network access. It read supplied bytes, recomputed hashes and parsed JSON. No control, phase gate or execution gate is closed by it, and no green state is declared anywhere.
false_green_increment.avoided_false_green: Issuing DOCUMENTARY_CLOSURE_PASS here would have risked a ninth false green of the FALSE_GREEN_7 class revision 2 identified: a validator declaring PASS on the strength of an authorization that is asserted rather than evidenced. Withholding the PASS is the specific function this gate performs.

All work was local and read-only.
authority_confirmation.this_artifact_grants: NOTHING. It is a read-only documentary review. It withholds canonicalization eligibility, closes no finding, authorizes no execution, mutation, cleanup, phase transition, canonicalization or subsequent gate, and creates no authority of any kind.
